How long a sealant lasts depends on the product, the use and the care.

Wie erkennen Sie Lackdefekte selbst?: How can you spot paint defects yourself?
Sie erkennen Lackdefekte am besten an ei: You can best spot paint defects on a clean, dry car using targeted light. In the shade or under a cloudy sky, fine scratches often remain invisible.
Stellen Sie das frisch gewaschene Auto i: Park the freshly washed car in direct sunlight. Look at the reflection of the sun in the paint from different angles. If you see fine circles around the point of light, those are car wash scratches. If shimmering streaks move with you as you move, they are holograms.
Ohne Sonne funktioniert der Test mit ein: Without sun, the test works with a bright LED torch or the light on your smartphone. In a dark garage or in the evening, hold the light at an angle to the paint and move it slowly. Scratches and streaks then become clearly visible.
Mit dem Fingernageltest prüfen Sie die T: The fingernail test lets you check the depth of individual scratches. Run your nail across the scratch. If it glides over, the scratch is usually in the clear coat and can often be polished out. If it catches or you see a light-coloured base layer, the scratch is usually too deep for polishing.
Stecken Sie Ihre Hand in eine dünne Plas: Put your hand in a thin plastic bag and run it over the clean paint. If the surface feels rough, bonded particles such as rail dust or tar residue are stuck there. They should be removed before polishing or sealing.

Warum gehören Politur und Versiegelung z: Why do polishing and sealing belong together?
Politur und Versiegelung gehören zusamme: Polishing and sealing belong together because freshly polished paint without protection quickly gets damaged again. Polishing creates a clean, smooth surface. The sealant protects exactly that condition.
Umgekehrt gilt: Wer stumpfen oder verkra: Conversely, if you only seal dull or scratched paint, you preserve the defects underneath. The combination is therefore usually the better choice when the paint has visible flaws.

Wie oft braucht ein Auto eine Politur?: How often does a car need polishing?
Eine Politur brauchen Sie nur, wenn der: You only need polishing when the paint shows visible defects. It is not a care step for every wash, because each polish removes some clear coat. The sealant, on the other hand, can be renewed regularly as soon as water no longer beads off well. If you wash gently and keep the paint protected, you will need to polish far less often.
